author: Yadzs

title: The App Bugging Out for DAYS
body:
There are entire days where the app would not respond to my updates and would revert my changes even after multiple tries. This happened for a couple of days where I re-tried checking off my daily activities and progresses and it would revert those changes as invalid. 

This is really bad because since this happened, I have not touched this app for a couple weeks and completely forgot about it. The app’s functionality is important because you’re trying to build habits to your users. If these features aren’t working at all, then there is no merit to opening the app, and therefore negates the entire point of this product. 

I imagine I’m not the only user that went back to the old habits once this app stopped working.

Better stick to a journal until they figure out a way to make this product stable.

title: Helped me stay disciplined
body:
This app has increased my productivity and task completion. I love the dailies the most because now I have a schedule on what to do instead of just going about my day with no goal in mind.

Not only am I productive, Im having fun too. Every time I tick a box whether its habits, dailies, or todos, it gives me this dopamine rush that motivates me to complete tomorrow’s quests too.

I also very much love how all these features are for FREE. Im super duper happy about it since Im still a student. 

Thank you devs for this wonderful app. I love it so much! Ive only used it for a week but I can say with confidence that I’ll be using it forever.

title: Great app
body:
Things I like about the app:
1. Free and not restricting any of its features to just paid customers. I love that there’s no limit on how many habits, dallies and todos free users can create. 
2. Gamification of habits and todos really helped me become more productive.
3. Party, quest and challenges these things helped me meet new people and created a healthy competitive environment. 

Some suggestions:
1. Add a calendar that shows streaks/misses for dallies and habits.
2. On the todos page add a categories folder for all, completed and not completed todo items. Put the folders on top of the page and the todo items on the bottom.
3. Don’t delete todo items even when the deadline has been reached instead store them in folders classified as completed or not completed to show the user an overview of their progress.
4. Bring back the guild this was very useful for finding people with similar goals and interests. This feature helps people compete with other people that have similar goals, it’s also a wonderful place to communicate with people, learn and share productivity hacks and tips.

title: Habitica is Great!
body: This app is not a game. It is a gamified experience of real life. It's fun because you can participate in it without thinking you’re wasting time. It also has instant gratification, which can replace other outlets that also have instant gratification but have no real value. With effort, patience, and a mindset that soars to the sky, you level up in-game as well as in real life. This is what real life should be about, having fun in hardships moving forward!

title: Love Habitica but App Needs Work
body:
Habitica is an effective tool to keep you on track. If it weren't, I would've deleted the app already. I love how it gamefies the entire process of forming habits and allows you to connect with other like-minded people. The app, however, needs a lot of work.

1) App takes a LONG time to respond; experience on the app isn't as smooth as using other apps on the iPhone. It constantly lags and there are actions that I have to do twice before they register on the app

2) Reminders for dailies and to-dos do not work at all. What's the point of being able to set reminders when they don't work? I wanted to use just this app but I ended up downloading another app for reminders

Other suggestions:
- Allow for notifications when user is mentioned in the Party chat
